title: the old shared service token refused outside DEV and TEST (card 9g-13)
note: no container was started (no Docker daemon): the compose files were read, the installer's lines and the pre-start command were run on a deploy folder; H9G13-02 to -12 come from the integrator's review of 9g-13 at 5a421d64 (#1267), each with its test in tests/unit/test_legacy_token_review.py

findings.claim: the token layer passes the old shared token on to the gateway's changing calls by the callee's name outside DEV and TEST (the orchestrator's pass-through is gone: make_app hands its refusal to the orchestrator's route gate); the gateway refuses it on chat and swap with an audit event, but POST /v1/serving/release answers 200 when the model swap is off; the gateway's own route gate (services/gateway/app.py, another lane's file) closes it and is asked on #639

a PRODUCTION box without the secrets overlay in COMPOSE_FILE (installed before step 8, never installed again) loses its services once they refuse the old token; doctor, the update preflight and the first pre-start step now name the missing overlay and the fix (deploy/install.sh, then secrets rotate), and secrets rotate is refused there

an update applied by an older release's update code did not run the new preflight refusal (review of 9g-13, High); the new tree's pre-start, which every updater since UPDATE-PRESTART runs before the stack starts, refuses first
a registry with the same hash under legacy and under a service identified the old token as that service (operator), so it was not refused in PRODUCTION; the legacy mark is now decided first

the gateway's compose environment set TB_ENV as ${TB_ENV:-PRODUCTION}, which the shell running compose could override (DEV), so the gateway accepted the old token on a PRODUCTION box; it now takes TB_ENV from deploy/.env only

POST /v1/serving/release answered 200 to the old token on a PRODUCTION box with the model swap off (the gateway write pass-through; it answers before it looks at the caller), with no refusal recorded; closed by the gateway's own route gate, a separate commit in services/gateway/app.py asked on #639

secrets rotate on a box whose COMPOSE_FILE lacked the secrets overlay removed the shared token while no service mounted its own, so the next recreation answered 503; rotation of tokens is refused there
box-install.sh --firstrun applied the owner's answers through the settings wizard, whose environment carries a random TB_SERVICE_TOKEN, back into deploy/.env; tools.box apply now drops it
a TB_SERVICE_TOKEN_FILE in deploy/.env with no registry (one file-backed token for the box) was missed by doctor and the preflight while the services call it legacy; it is held now
doctor --env-file read the sibling deploy/.env instead of the file given; it reads the file given now
the updater kept the quotes of TB_ENV="TEST" and took it for PRODUCTION, refusing a TEST box's update; quotes are read as compose reads them
the installed-box test did not check that each callee mounts the registry it needs; a test checks TB_SERVICE_TOKENS and the mount for every service
